newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco lowers Feb tariffs for industry.
newsitem.headline: Meralco lowers Feb tariffs for industry.

text.p: Manila Electric Co (Meralco) said on Thursday it will charge a lower tariff from its industrial and large commercial customers in February due to a lower system losses of power in 1996.
It said power losses in the year were 12.15 percent of output against 13 percent in 1995.

Meralco's price for industrial and commercial clients will be lowered by 4.5 centavos per kilowatt-hour (kwh) from the current rate of 3.34 pesos per kwh, the utility said in a statement. These sectors comprise about 70 percent of Meralco's sales.
The lower price will be implemented despite of the fact that that cost of purchased power had remained the same, the company said.
Meralco gets its power from the state-owned National Power Corp (Napocor) which had a generation charge of 2.3035 peso per kwh in January versus 2.3031 pesos per kwh in December 1996.
